profiles.position: Member of the Dewan Rakyat; Deputy President of MIC
profiles.description: Saravanan Murugan represents Tapah, Perak, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Member of the Dewan Rakyat; Deputy President of MIC. A MIC member.

profile_sources.label: MIC · parliamentary representative and deputy president

milestones.title: Hold the first Gopeng Temu Rakyat service programme
milestones.description: Tan’s constituency programme brought government service counters and complaints channels to Sungai Rapat, with ten participating agencies.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers the first event only. Expansion to Teja and Simpang Pulai and resolution of every complaint are separate, unverified outcomes.

milestones.title: Advance preparations for a replacement Gopeng Tamil school building
milestones.description: Tan announced preparations for a new building after federal funding approval following his earlier request.
milestones.progress_note: The allocation and preparation announcement do not establish a finished building. A March 2026 report separately described a 22-month construction schedule; no completion percentage or exact final date is inferred.

milestones.title: Install 200 solar LED street lights in Tapah over three years
milestones.description: Saravanan announced a phased installation funded from his parliamentary allocation, prioritising accident-prone stretches.
milestones.progress_note: June coordination and a September plan for the first 20 lights are documented. Actual installation was not verified; 20 planned units are not a 10% completion score. The rolling three-year period is not converted into an exact-day deadline.
